name: IIM Ahmedabad
about: IIM Ahmedabad is India's top business school, established in 1961, known for its Case Study methodology and iconic Louis Kahn campus. It consistently ranks #1 in NIRF for management education.
placement_detail: 100% placement record. Top recruiters include McKinsey, BCG, Goldman Sachs, and Hindustan Unilever.
admission: Requires CAT score (99.5+ percentile), followed by AWT and PI rounds.

name: IIM Bangalore
about: IIM Bangalore (IIMB) is one of the premier management schools in Asia, known for its emphasis on entrepreneurship and innovation along with strong industry connections in the tech hub of Bangalore.
placement_detail: 100% placement. Top sectors: Consulting, BFSI, Technology. Recruiters include Amazon, Deloitte, EY.
admission: CAT score followed by Written Ability Test (WAT) and Personal Interview (PI).

name: IIM Calcutta
about: IIM Calcutta is the oldest IIM, established in 1961 in collaboration with MIT Sloan School of Management. Known for rigorous quantitative finance and consulting programs.
placement_detail: 100% placement. Dominant sectors: Finance, Consulting. Top firms: Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, BCG.
admission: CAT followed by WAT and PI.

name: FMS Delhi
about: Faculty of Management Studies (FMS), Delhi University is India's best ROI MBA program. With fees under ₹2 Lakhs and placements averaging ₹32+ LPA, it offers unmatched value. One of the oldest and most prestigious management schools.
placement_detail: 100% placement. Top companies: Google, Amazon, Bain, McKinsey, HDFC Bank. India's best ROI management program.
admission: High CAT percentile (99%+) followed by GD and PI at FMS campus.

name: MDI Gurgaon
about: Management Development Institute (MDI) Gurgaon is an AACSB and AMBA accredited business school in the corporate hub of Gurgaon, offering some of the best industry exposure in India.
placement_detail: Top recruiters: Deloitte, KPMG, Hindustan Unilever, Asian Paints, Amazon.
admission: CAT/XAT followed by GD, Essay Writing, and PI.

name: XLRI Jamshedpur
about: XLRI - Xavier School of Management is one of India's oldest and most prestigious B-schools, particularly renowned for its HRM and Business Management programs.
placement_detail: Top sectors: Consulting, BFSI, FMCG, HR. Top firms: Nestlé, P&G, TATA, Deloitte, EY.
admission: XAT or GMAT score followed by GD and PI.

name: SPJIMR Mumbai
about: S.P. Jain Institute of Management and Research (SPJIMR) is known for its purpose-led management education model with a strong focus on social responsibility and ethics.
placement_detail: Top companies: Amazon, BCG, Unilever, HDFC, Tata Sons. Strong in FMCG, Consulting, Finance.
admission: CAT/GMAT followed by Group Exercise, Case Discussion, and Personal Interview.

name: IIFT Delhi
about: Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) is Asia's foremost institution for International Business education. Excellent for students targeting global trade, export-import, and international finance careers.
placement_detail: Top recruiters: Amazon, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, Maersk, DHL, Standard Chartered.
admission: IIFT entrance exam or CAT, followed by GD and PI.

name: NMIMS Mumbai
about: Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies (NMIMS) is a deemed university in Mumbai's business district, known for strong placement records in finance and marketing sectors.
placement_detail: Top firms: Deloitte, EY, KPMG, Amazon, HDFC, Axis Bank. Strong in Finance and Marketing.
admission: NMAT by GMAC score, followed by Case Discussion and Personal Interview.

name: Great Lakes Institute of Management
about: Great Lakes Institute of Management offers specialized management education with strong industry interface. The Gurgaon campus focuses on the tech and startup ecosystem.
placement_detail: Top companies: Amazon, Accenture, Deloitte, ICICI Bank, Infosys BPO.
admission: CAT/XAT/GMAT/CMAT followed by PI.

name: IIT Delhi
about: IIT Delhi is among India's most prestigious engineering institutions. Located in the nation's capital, it has produced some of India's most successful engineers, scientists, and entrepreneurs.
placement_detail: Top recruiters: Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Goldman Sachs, Qualcomm. Strong in tech and core engineering.
admission: JEE Advanced rank. CSE: Top 100 ranks typically required.
cutoff: Top 500 JEE Advanced rank for CSE

name: IIT Bombay
about: IIT Bombay is India's most research-intensive engineering institute. Located in Mumbai, it has the highest international rankings among IITs and is known for its entrepreneurial culture with one of India's best incubators.
placement_detail: Highest placements among IITs. Top firms: Google, Apple, Uber, Ola, D.E. Shaw. ₹3.67 Cr international package in 2024.
admission: JEE Advanced. Among the most competitive JEE Advanced cutoffs.
cutoff: Top 200 JEE Advanced rank for CSE

name: VIT Vellore
about: VIT Vellore is one of India's largest private engineering universities with world-class infrastructure and strong multinational company placements. Known for its international collaborations and industry-oriented curriculum.
placement_detail: 5000+ companies recruit from VIT. Top companies: TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Amazon, Cognizant, Zoho, Microsoft.
admission: VITEEE entrance exam or JEE Main score. Direct admission available for qualifying students.

name: SRM Institute of Science and Technology
about: SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) is one of the top-ranked private engineering universities in India with over 50,000 students and 1800+ faculty members.
placement_detail: 4000+ companies visit campus. Top companies: Amazon, Deloitte, Cognizant, Capgemini, Zoho, HCL.
admission: SRMJEEE or JEE Main. Also accepts 12th board merit in some cases.

name: Manipal Institute of Technology
about: Manipal University Jaipur is a NAAC A+ accredited private university offering world-class engineering education under the prestigious Manipal Education Group brand.
placement_detail: Strong Manipal group network. Top companies: TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Capgemini, L&T.
admission: MET (Manipal Entrance Test) or JEE Main score.

name: BITS Pilani
about: BITS Pilani is one of India's finest private engineering institutions, known for its practice school internship program, strong alumni network in top tech companies, and industry-aligned curriculum.
placement_detail: Among best private universities for placements. Top companies: Google, Microsoft, Qualcomm, Goldman Sachs, Intel.
admission: BITSAT exam only. No JEE Main accepted.

name: DTU Delhi
about: Delhi Technological University (DTU) is one of Delhi's top engineering institutions and a JEE Main-accepting college with excellent placement records and a strong alumni network in Delhi NCR's corporate ecosystem.
placement_detail: Strong Delhi NCR placements. Top companies: Amazon, Microsoft, Samsung, Adobe, Qualcomm, JPMC.
admission: JEE Main rank. Delhi domicile and all-India seats available.
cutoff: 98+ JEE Main percentile for CSE (Delhi quota)

name: NSUT Delhi
about: Netaji Subhas University of Technology (NSUT), formerly NSIT, is a leading state government engineering university in Delhi known for its computer science and electronics programs.
placement_detail: Top companies: Google, Adobe, Amazon, Microsoft, Zomato, Ola. Strong CS/IT placements.
admission: JEE Main rank. Delhi quota seats prioritized.
cutoff: 97+ JEE Main percentile for CSE (Delhi quota)

name: RVCE Bangalore
about: RV College of Engineering (RVCE) is one of Bangalore's top engineering institutions, consistently ranked among the best private engineering colleges in Karnataka. Known for strong industry ties in India's Silicon Valley.
placement_detail: Top companies: Amazon, Microsoft, Cisco, Intel, Wipro, Accenture, Capgemini.
admission: KCET, COMEDK, or JEE Main scores.
cutoff: KCET rank < 2000 for CSE; COMEDK rank < 1000

name: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology
about: Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology is a NAAC A+ accredited deemed university known for its strong research culture, industry collaboration, and excellent placements in the tech sector.
placement_detail: Top companies: Microsoft, Amazon, Samsung, Nvidia, Qualcomm, Zomato, Flipkart.
admission: JEE Main score. Direct admission on merit.

name: Christ University Bangalore
about: Christ University (Deemed-to-be) is one of South India's premier universities for arts, commerce, and management. Known for holistic education, strong value system, and excellent BBA and BCA programs.
placement_detail: Top companies for BBA: Deloitte, EY, Accenture, HDFC, Axis Bank, Swiggy. BCA: Infosys, Capgemini, Wipro.
admission: CUET score or Christ University Entrance Test. Merit-based with English proficiency test.

name: Symbiosis Centre for Management Studies (SCMS) Pune
about: SCMS Pune is one of India's top BBA colleges under the Symbiosis International University umbrella. Known for its industry-integrated curriculum, diverse student body, and strong alumni network.
placement_detail: Top companies: Amazon, Deloitte, EY, HDFC Bank, Asian Paints, Reliance, Myntra.
admission: SET (Symbiosis Entrance Test) score required. WAT and PI follow.

name: Narsee Monjee College of Commerce & Economics
about: The Anil Surendra Modi School of Commerce at NMIMS offers one of Mumbai's most sought-after BBA programs with deep industry connections in India's financial capital.
placement_detail: Top recruiters: KPMG, Deloitte, ICICI Bank, Kotak, EY, Mckinsey intern programs.
admission: NMAT score or 12th merit basis. High 12th board percentage required.

name: Amity University Noida
about: Amity University Noida is one of India's largest private universities, offering 250+ programs. Known for world-class infrastructure, global partnerships, and a diverse student community in the Delhi NCR region.
placement_detail: 3000+ companies recruit from Amity. Top companies: TCS, Infosys, HCL, Amazon, Cognizant, Wipro.
admission: AMEAT or merit basis. Some programs use JEE Main / CUET scores.

name: Bennett University Greater Noida
about: Bennett University, backed by the Times of India Group, is a new-age university known for its journalism, media, and technology programs. Strong focus on entrepreneurship with direct media industry connections.
placement_detail: Strong tech placements. Top companies: TCS, Infosys, Amazon, Samsung, Nykaa, Times Internet.
admission: JEE Main score or Bennett University's own entrance test.

name: Sharda University Greater Noida
about: Sharda University is a NAAC A+ accredited multidisciplinary university known for its large international student community, affordable fees, and comprehensive programs across engineering, management, and law.
placement_detail: Top companies: TCS, Infosys, HCL, Wipro, Amazon, Cognizant, HDFC.
admission: JEE Main, CUET, or direct merit basis.

name: UPES Dehradun
about: University of Petroleum and Energy Studies (UPES) is India's specialized university for energy, engineering, and business. Known for niche programs in oil & gas, logistics, and aviation engineering.
placement_detail: Specialized placements: Shell, ONGC, HPCL, Reliance Industries, Halliburton. Tech: Amazon, Wipro, TCS.
admission: JEE Main or UPESEAT or merit basis.

name: Graphic Era University Dehradun
about: Graphic Era University is a NAAC A+ university in the foothills of the Himalayas, known for its beautiful campus, affordable engineering education, and growing placements in IT sector.
placement_detail: Top companies: TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, Cognizant, Tech Mahindra.
admission: JEE Main score or merit basis in 12th.

name: Lovely Professional University
about: Lovely Professional University (LPU) is one of India's largest private universities with over 30,000+ students, offering 200+ programs. Known for its massive campus, global collaborations, and strong placement drive.
placement_detail: 900+ recruiters. Top companies: TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Amazon, HCL, Capgemini.
admission: LPUNEST, JEE Main, or CUET. Scholarships available for high scorers.
